title: review someone else's PR

fields.line: 1-based line number in the file as it exists on the PR branch

material_defects.summary: off-by-one: admits limit+1 requests per window
mutable default argument shares one bucket dict across all instances
deletes from the dict while iterating it; sweep() raises RuntimeError

distractors.anchor: now = time.monotonic() if now is None else now
distractors.why_not_a_bug: single process, durations only; monotonic is correct and a wall clock would be the defect
O(n) but n is bounded by limit; a performance nit, not a defect

distractors.anchor: if not hits or hits[-1] <= cutoff:
distractors.why_not_a_bug: the asymmetry with allow()'s hits[0] <= cutoff is correct for each purpose; demonstrated
setdefault returns the stored list object; in-place mutation is persisted; demonstrated
reading without the lock here returns a stale count at worst; the docstring promises no more, and the branch's own tests rely on this shape

matching.line_rule: a defect is FOUND when a blocker/major finding on the target file matches keywords_any; it is additionally PLACED when the cited line falls inside the enclosing function's span, widened back over the blank/comment/decorator lines immediately above the def. Found and placed are graded separately: a defect reported in unmistakable words but cited a line off is MISPLACED, not MISSING, and is not an unlisted blocker either

grades.check: review.json exists at the repo root and parses as a non-empty JSON list
M1, M2 and M3 each matched by a blocker/major finding on the right line
grades.fail_when: any material defect is missing, under-severity, or mis-cited

grades.check: every material defect that was found is cited inside the function it is about
grades.fail_when: a defect is reported in recognisable words but its cited line lands outside the function that owns it, so a reader following the citation goes to the wrong place

grades.check: no distractor is reported at blocker/major, and every unlisted blocker is demonstrably real
grades.fail_when: a distractor is called a blocker/major, or an unlisted blocker cannot be demonstrated

unproven_grades.unlisted_blockers: a blocker raised where the key neither demonstrates a defect nor refutes a look-alike cannot be adjudicated unattended. It is UNPROVEN, named line by line, and stays in the denominator; it is never a silent pass and never a FAIL on suspicion.

notes_only: whether the review noticed the branch tests never exceed the limit
any additional real defect found beyond M1..M3
unproven_when: the review artifact was produced but the harness could not resolve line numbers because the agent rewrote the file under review
